name: MAIR-Queries
description:
MAIR: A Massive Benchmark for Evaluating Instructed Retrieval
	

MAIR is a heterogeneous IR benchmark that comprises 126 information retrieval tasks across 6 domains, with annotated query-level instructions to clarify each retrieval task and relevance criteria. 
This repository contains the query data for MAIR, while the document collections are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/MAIR-Bench/MAIR-Docs.

Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.10127
